data.body: ADR number collision 2026-11-09 (PST): another session's worktree adr-0123-plan-engine holds commit 93a8eea0870 adding docs/adr/0123-selectable-plan-review-engine.md (ticket 11f7-cf57-be02-4441), while Gerrit change 3337 had also claimed 0123. Change 3337 is held until release 0.14.1 is cut, so it yields: the fix-versions ADR is renumbered to 0124 (free on main, every local branch and worktree, and open Gerrit changes at the time of the check). Child ticket descriptions now cite ADR 0124; earlier comments citing ADR 0123 for this design mean ADR 0124.
